questions.prompt: The review found that the bank CLI accepts 1e3 as a deposit. Explain why: how readAmount parses the text, why Money's validation cannot catch it, which boundary owns which kind of rule, and the reference fix, including what is still left to Money afterwards.

keyPoints.text: readAmount parses the text with new BigDecimal(amountText).
So 1e3 becomes a deposit of 1000.00.
Money validates the number, so it cannot see that the text was surprising.
keyPoints.quote: it validates the *number*, so it cannot see that the *text* was surprising.

keyPoints.text: Input-format rules belong at the adapter; value rules belong in the domain.
keyPoints.quote: Input-format rules belong at the adapter, value rules in the domain.

keyPoints.text: Fix: match the text against a plain-decimal pattern before parsing.
Sub-cent rejection stays in Money, so the two checks have different jobs.
keyPoints.quote: Leave sub-cent rejection to `Money`; the two checks now have different jobs.

questions.prompt: Why does the bank simulator load a hand-edited balance without complaint, and what does fixing that cost? Explain what load-time validation checks, what the END footer does and does not verify, what the reproduction showed, the reconciliation fix, why it breaks many existing tests, and the right way to repair those tests.

keyPoints.text: Load-time validation checks ids and references only.
The END footer counts records; it is not a checksum.
keyPoints.quote: counts records; it is not a checksum.

keyPoints.text: Raising a balance from 1000.00 to 999999.00 in the snapshot loads silently and is listed.
Fix: sum the signed history per account in the constructor and compare it with the balance.
keyPoints.quote: Sum the signed history per account in the constructor and compare it with the balance.

keyPoints.text: The test fixture seeds balances with no history, so a naive check failed 16 of 28 regression tests.
keyPoints.quote: a naive reconciliation check made 16 of the 28 regression tests fail

keyPoints.text: Repair the fixtures by modelling an opening balance explicitly, not by disabling the check.
keyPoints.quote: Fix the fixtures by modelling an opening balance explicitly (an `OPENING` entry or a migration), not by disabling the check.

questions.prompt: How should BankService be wrapped when it is reused behind a server? Describe the unit-of-work sketch step by step and what happens if the save throws, the rule every reader and writer must follow, what a database version should do instead of cloning, how outcomes map to HTTP status codes and who translates versus enforces, and how idempotency keys should behave, including the hardest case.

keyPoints.text: Under a coordinator lock, build a candidate service from the current snapshot and apply the validated command to it.
Save the candidate's snapshot; if that throws, keep current; only then make the candidate current.
Every reader and writer must go through the coordinator, or the live reference escapes.
keyPoints.quote: Every reader and writer must go through the coordinator, or the live reference escapes.

keyPoints.text: A database version puts the related writes and the idempotency record in one transaction instead of cloning the dataset.
keyPoints.quote: put the related writes and the idempotency record in one transaction

keyPoints.text: Invalid input maps to 400, a missing or foreign account to 404 without revealing it exists, and insufficient funds or a version conflict to 409.
keyPoints.quote: Map invalid input to 400, a missing or foreign account to 404 (do not reveal that it exists), and insufficient funds or a version conflict to 409.

keyPoints.text: Controllers translate; the command path enforces.
keyPoints.quote: Controllers translate; the command path enforces.

keyPoints.text: Same key and same payload replays the stored result; same key with a different payload is a conflict.
keyPoints.quote: The same key with the same payload replays the result; the same key with a different payload is a conflict.

keyPoints.text: Cover the ambiguous case where the commit succeeded but the client never saw the response.
keyPoints.quote: Include the ambiguous case where the commit succeeded but the client never saw the response.
